messages:
Lina Torres: Hi all, Lina here in API team 025-11-01. Quick security/setup q since I9m still waiting on my laptop: 1) Do I need to enroll my personal Mac into Jamf to get access to the #eng-dedicated channel? 2) I saw a phish sim notification 025-11-04 5: am I automatically included if I don9t have a company device yet? 3) How do I check FileVault and what should I do if it9s off?

Omar (People Ops): welcome Lina! :wave: You don9t need to enroll a personal device. Facilities can issue a loaner until your machine arrives. We mark new hires on personal devices as exempt from phishing sims until they have a managed device. Please finish Security Basics + Data Handling within 72 hours to get full channel access.

Nina IT: @Lina - to check FileVault open Terminal and run `fdesetup status`. If it returns "FileVault is Off" you should enable it via System Settings > Privacy & Security > FileVault > Turn On. If you want we can do one-click enrollment from the invite link once your device arrives.

Lina Torres: ran `fdesetup status` -> "FileVault is Off". I9m happy to enable but want to confirm Jamf on personal devices only applies minimal checks?

Nina IT: Correct. For personal devices we offer a minimal "temporary-managed" policy: enforces disk encryption, passcode, screen lock timeout; does not install corporate certs or mail profiles. But again, you can opt for a loaner instead.

Casey InfoSec: MFA enrollment is independent; please complete that ASAP. For phishing: if you get a loaner you9re included; otherwise we defer your sim. We also recommend completing the Security Basics module before the sim 025-11-04.

PhishSimBot: User Lina Torres added to the upcoming phishing cohort on 2025-11-04. Reply with "loaner-request" to request exemption until a managed device is assigned.

Lina Torres: loaner-request. Also, can Facilities leave the loaner with a privacy screen? I9m commuting some days.

Facilities: Loaner request received for Lina Torres. We can include a privacy screen; choose delivery or pickup in the loaner form: https://redwood.intranet/facilities/loaner-form. Estimated delivery 2 business days after approval.

Omar (People Ops): Marked Lina exempt for the upcoming phishing cohort and added to the onboarding tracker. You9ll still need to finish the Security Basics course for channel gating. Welcome aboard! :tada:

Lina Torres: Thanks all 5: enabled FileVault and filled the loaner form. I9ll wait for the Jamf invite on my company device when it arrives. Appreciate the quick responses!
